en: A vintage postcard depicting a busy sandy beach with sunbathers and swimmers, set against terraced hills with several modernist mid-20th-century buildings, likely hotels or resorts. The view is from the water, looking up towards the structures and green hills. The reverse side includes multilingual labeling, stamp box, and address lines, with printed and handwritten numbers and Bulgarian Cyrillic text.
